name: Train tab cycle banner
gap: Train carries no cycle banner; the only 'cycle' in train.html is the outdoor-cycling cardio activity.

name: Exercise detail sheet
gap: Sheet renders (map, four facts, history, actions) but the primary action only toasts: "Start a workout with this" and "Add to today's workout" write nothing and do not navigate; only "Add to a split day" persists.

name: Per-exercise personal notes (autosaving)
gap: Per-exercise notes autosave to lk_exNotes from the workout log only; the library detail sheet has no notes field at all, so a note cannot be written or read where the lift is browsed.

name: Form-video lookup and cache
gap: The three media states exist as a slot but nothing looks a clip up and nothing is cached: S.media is only reachable from the dev switcher, media-retry always lands on error, and the log's own sheet says "No form video found for this exercise."

name: Cardio v1 → v2 migration (runs on load)
gap: No migration of any kind. Nothing reads lk_cardioMigrated, nothing maps v1 cardioType/minutes/intensity onto the v2 modality/durationSec/RPE shape; a phone carrying v1 cardio rows would render them empty.

name: Split builder — add a note "Block" to a day
gap: A split day has no Block. persistSplit writes blocks:[] unconditionally, there is no add-block control and no block row, so a note or timed section cannot be put in a programmed day at all.

name: Train tab shell: header, Cardio + Quick Start, sub-tabs
gap: The header and the cardio block are here; the other two thirds of the shell are gone by decision. Source comment: "ALSO CUT. Quick Start (an accent fill that started an empty workout while the programmed session sat below the fold)" and, of the sub-tabs, "The four things this screen holds are not peers you switch between".

name: My Splits empty state (Build Manually / AI Split Builder)
gap: The empty state is here but offers one action, not two: "Nothing has been earned yet, so nothing is claimed and nothing competes: one sentence, one action. The audited empty state offered two." The AI builder therefore has no entrance from an empty Train.

name: Exercise Library (inline + full-screen)
gap: Only the full-screen library exists, as its own page reached from a Reference row. There is no inline library inside Train, and over file:// the page falls back to a 227-row inline catalogue while the Train row still says "of 867 logged".

name: AI Split Builder — mode picker
gap: There is no mode picker. The AI builder is reached from one tertiary button in the manual builder's empty state ("Let LOCKED draft it"); the two-card choice between Chat and Import from Photo does not exist.

name: AI Split Builder — Import from Photo / describe your split
gap: No photo import anywhere: no file input, no preview, no note field, nothing. Broken in v6 and not rebuilt; it also needs a vision model behind a server.

name: Favorites — quick chips (one-tap re-log)
gap: The quick rows are here and prefilled, but they are not one-tap: the row opens the duration sheet instead of logging. Source comment: "'logged 30 minutes' when it was 22 is a wrong number in the record, and the shipped app asked."

name: History — group filter chips
gap: The only history filter is the three-way All / Lifting / Cardio segment. There are no per-activity-group chips (machines, outdoors, water, studio), so a cardio history of any size cannot be narrowed to a kind of session.

name: Unit conversion on the way into the engine (`draft`)
gap: Only pack weight is converted on the way in. Distance is hard-coded to kilometres (FIELD.dist unit "km", no LKUnits path), so a reader in pounds types km and the detail, the pace and the bests all read km.

name: Log flow — step 4: the summary ("Logged")
gap: The summary is here and honest about the estimate, but the Surface row falls back to the machine id: a treadmill run logged from this screen reads "Surface  treadrun".

name: Favourite creation / toggling (star)
gap: A favourite can only be made from the one "Save this setup" button on the just-logged sheet. There is no star on an activity row, a quick row or a history row, so an existing session cannot be favourited and nothing can be un-favourited except from inside the Favourites sheet.
